faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.desc: Everything you need to know when planning your health journey.

faqs.question: Is it really safe to get treatment in Türkiye?
faqs.answer: Yes. Türkiye holds one of the highest numbers of JCI (Joint Commission International) accreditations worldwide. All Akem Health surgeons are members of ISAPS, EBOPRAS or ISHRS, and procedures take place only in fully equipped A+ JCI-accredited hospitals.

faqs.question: How are flights and transfers arranged?
faqs.answer: Your patient coordinator works with you to choose flight dates. You're greeted by name the moment you land in Istanbul, and your private VIP vehicle takes you straight to your 5-star partner hotel. All hospital-hotel-airport transfers are included in your package.

faqs.question: Will there be a language barrier?
faqs.answer: Not at all. A personal medical interpreter who speaks your native language — English, Russian, Arabic, Turkish and more — accompanies you to every appointment throughout your treatment.

faqs.question: How is follow-up handled after I return home?
faqs.answer: Our mobile and video follow-up protocol stays active for 1 year after treatment. At set intervals (months 1, 3, 6 and 12) your physician reviews photo check-ins and recovery results.

storyParagraphs: Akem Health was founded by a team of medical travel coordinators and clinicians who saw international patients repeatedly struggle with the same problems: unclear pricing, language barriers, and uncoordinated care between hospitals, hotels and transport.

We built Akem Health to remove every one of those frictions — a single, accountable partner who manages the entire journey, from your first online consultation to your final follow-up call a year later.

Today, we work exclusively with JCI-accredited hospitals and board-certified surgeons, and every package is built to the same standard: full transparency, no hidden costs, and a guarantee you can rely on.
